verification.reason: Source-only operation probes cover successful allocation and the native allocation-failure return, including directory order, minimum/large buffer sizing, stage images, text entries, update-pump count, and final status. Sprite-library reader behavior remains covered by the separate 176-file SG3 verifier; this orchestration test starts with its manager already full to isolate setup ordering.

known_limitations: Rendering, filesystem, allocation and progress-pump effects are required typed operations supplied by the eventual runtime composition. The campaign-selection field name is inferred from native consumers; the original function body observes only return values 0 and 1 even though its caller checks additional legacy values.
